project_type: Python FastAPI backend - autonomous AI company OS
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio (asyncio_mode=auto), tests/ directory, conftest.py with mock_db_session fixtures
verification_instructions: Run pytest from project root. All 1425 existing tests + new tests must pass.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Python 3.12 required. Do NOT touch dashboard/ directory.
contribution_requirements: All code must have docstrings, type hints, Python 3.12 style (type unions with |). Follow ruff rules (100 char lines, E/F/I/N/W/UP). Modules must be independently testable.
key_patterns: Pydantic BaseModel for API request/response models. Dataclasses for internal state. In-memory state classes (no DB required for new modules). Tests use plain pytest classes (TestXxx) with descriptive test methods. Existing patterns: ControlRegistry-like classes use a dict/map internally, expose typed methods, return typed results. Modules separate types into _types.py files (breaker_types.py pattern). API routes use FastAPI APIRouter with tags.
directory_structure: src/nexus/ is the main package. Subpackages: governance/, memory/, knowledge/, communication/, runtime/, api/routes/. Tests in tests/ at project root. Each domain module has its own types file (e.g., breaker_types.py). API routes are in src/nexus/api/routes/ and follow FastAPI router pattern.
